title: A Distribution Mapping Approach to Counterfactually Fair Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.08743v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) seeks to optimize sequential decisions to maximize population-level benefits over time. However, when deployed in high-stakes settings such as healthcare, RL decisions might systematically restrict some subpopulation's access to valuable services in a manner contrary to the values and goals of stakeholders. Counterfactual fairness (CF) offers a promising framework to address this problem based on causal reasoning. This paper develops a data preprocessing algorithm that, when used in tandem with policy learning, enables CF in RL. Our algorithm relies on a novel quantile distribution mapping method for sequentially estimating the counterfactual states and rewards in the data preprocessing step, subsuming common additivity assumptions used for counterfactual prediction as a special case. translated_title: 反事实公平强化学习的分布映射方法
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）旨在通过优化序贯决策来最大化长期的群体收益。然而，在医疗保健等高风险场景中部署时，强化学习的决策可能系统性地限制某些亚群体获取有价值服务的机会，这与利益相关者的价值观和目标相违背。反事实公平性（CF）提供了一个基于因果推理来解决这一问题的有前景的框架。本文提出了一种数据预处理算法，将其与策略学习结合使用时，能够在强化学习中实现反事实公平性。我们的算法依赖于一种新颖的分位数分布映射方法，在数据预处理步骤中序贯地估计反事实状态和奖励，并将反事实预测中常用的可加性假设作为特例纳入其中。我们从理论上证明了每步的反事实不公平程度和无限时域的次优差距……
tldr: 本文提出一种基于分位数分布映射的数据预处理算法，通过序贯估计反事实状态和奖励，在强化学习中实现反事实公平性，并将常用的可加性假设作为特例涵盖其中。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel quantile distribution mapping-based data preprocessing algorithm that sequentially estimates counterfactual states and rewards to enable counterfactually fair reinforcement learning, subsuming common additivity assumptions as a special case.
